CONFIDENTIAL REPORT
DRAWER

Subject (in full) Manchoukuo Trade Representative to Central China.

Made by D. S. Kamashita Forwarded by C. Crawford. S.I.

Mr. Wong Ching Chang(王慶璋), newly appointed
trade representative to Central China of the Manchoukuo
Government, arrived in Shanghai aboard the s.s. "Dairen
Maru" on March 21, 1939. The office of this
representative was established in No. 152 Minghong Road.

D. S. Kamashita
D. S.

D. C. (Special Branch).

（批：P.A. to D.C. (Sp. Br.) 22/3）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Confidential Drawer
File No. 6860
16 - 11 - 35
Special Branch Station,
REPORT
Date November 16 1935.
Subject Manchukuo Office at No. 23 Minghong Road and private
telephone system at 363 Boone Road.
Made by and Forwarded by C.D.I. Grubb
Enquiries made regarding the report that a private
telephone system belonging to a Japanese, which has eighteen
different lines, is installed at 363 Boone Road, show that
this number is allotted to a cigarette and exchange shop
situated at the entrance to an alleyway and owned by a Chinese.
The next number, 365, is a clock and gramophone shop owned
by a Japanese. An inspection of these premises from the
outside failed to disclose any sign of a number of telephone lines
Regarding the establishment of an office for
Manchukuo affairs at No. 23 Minghong Road, the portion of the
building to which this number is allotted is used as a wharf
office by the N.Y.K. This building, which faces Yangtsze Road,
extends from Minghong to Woochang Roads. A part of it numbered
1 Yangtsze Road, is used as Japanese Consular offices and the
building seems quite a likely place for an office wherein
affairs pertaining to Manchukuo would be dealt with.
The Japanese Consulate, the rear part of which is
situated on the corner of Woochang and Yangtsze Roads, and the
building referred to are always guarded by Consular Police,
therefore no attempt was made to pursue investigations inside
the premises.
C. D. I.
D. C. (Special Branch).
16 NOV. 1935

报告
日期：1935年11月16日。
主题：明宏路23号的满洲国办事处及布恩路363号的私人电话系统。
由 C.D.I. Grubb 制作并转呈
针对有关一名日本人拥有的、拥有十八条不同线路的私人电话系统安装在布恩路363号的报告所进行的查询显示，该号码分配给一家位于巷口、由中国人所有的香烟及兑换店。下一个号码365号是一家由日本人所有的钟表及留声机商店。从外部对这些场所进行检查，未发现有多条电话线路的迹象。
关于在明宏路23号设立满洲国事务办事处的情况，分配该门牌号的建筑部分被日本邮船会社（N.Y.K.）用作码头办事处。这栋面向扬子路的建筑，从明宏路延伸至武昌路。其中编为扬子路1号的部分被用作日本领事馆办公室，该建筑似乎相当适合作为处理满洲国相关事务的办公地点。
日本领事馆的后部位于武昌路与扬子路的拐角处，上述建筑始终由领事警察守卫，因此未尝试进入场所内部进行调查。
C. D. I.
D. C. （特别科）。
1935年11月16日

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. 6860
S.1 Special Branch Station,
REPORT
Date July 19 19 35.
Subject Organization of a Group named "The Grand Federation of China,
Manchukuo and Japan".
Made by and Forwarded by C.D.I.Grubb

No confirmation can be obtained of the report that
a China-Japan-Manchukuo League is in existence in Shanghai
with offices in Boone Road and that one named Liu Yau-ting
(劉耀廷) is the head of the group.
Liu Yau-ting alias Liu Ngoh-dz(劉玉池),age about
40, is a native of Weihaiwei and at present resides at Lane 117,
No. 12 Ping Liang Tsung, Pingliang Road. According to inquiries
made he was formerly a grocer in Vladivostock, but returned to
China following the outbreak of the Soviet Revolution.
Some seven years ago he came to Shanghai and stayed at the
home of one of his fellow countrymen named Liang Tsing-teh
(梁駿德) who was at that time an interpreter in the Kung
Dah Cotton Mill. Subsequently he established a glove and
ribbon factory at his present address, employing some 10 workers.
He speaks the Russian language but cannot speak Japanese,
although he has many acquaintances among seamen aboard various
Japanese steamers, mostly fellow countrymen. Through these
friends he has carried on the smuggling of radio parts from
Japan to China, from which he has made considerable profit.
The three Chinese named Mao Shao-Ching(馬少卿),
Wang King-loong(王金龍) and Wang King-pao(王金寶), stated
to be the Japanese representatives sent to Shanghai to organize
the group, cannot be located.
Enquiries made by D.I. Pan Lien Pih.

A. Grubb
C. D. I.
D. C. (Special Branch.) Reg.
Copies sent to unoff
authorities. Please file.
JHG

S.1 特别科分站，
报告
日期：1935年7月19日。
主题：名为“中日满大联盟”的团体的组织情况。
由 C.D.I.Grubb 制作并转呈

无法证实有关上海存在一个中日满联盟、其办事处设在布恩路、且一名叫劉耀廷的人是该团体头目的报告。

劉耀廷，别名劉玉池，年龄约40岁，威海卫人，目前居住在平凉路平凉宗12号117弄。据查询，他曾是符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）的一名杂货商，但在苏维埃革命爆发后返回中国。
大约七年前他来到上海，住在一位名叫梁駿德的同乡家中，梁当时是公大纱厂的翻译。随后，他在目前的地址开办了一家手套和丝带工厂，雇佣了约10名工人。
他会说俄语，但不会说日语，尽管他在各艘日本轮船上有很多熟人，大多是同乡。通过这些朋友，他从事从日本到中国的无线电零件走私活动，并从中获得了可观的利润。
据称是被派往上海组织该团体的日本代表的三名中国人馬少卿、王金龍和王金寶，无法找到。

由警探潘连璧进行查询。

A. Grubb
C. D. I.
D. C. （特别科。）登记

TRANSLATION FROM A FRENCH REPORT DATED JULY 4. 1935.

Subject. Organisation of a group named "The Grand Federation
of China, Manchuokuo, and Japan.

Reference:-
Grand Federation of China, Manchuokuo and Japan.
Sino/Japanese Relations.
Sino/Manchuokuo Relations.
Special Agent "K".

...............................

Special Agent "K" has communicated the following report:-
The Japanese have recently sent to Shanghai, three Chinese,
who represent Manchuokuo, their names are Mao Shao Ching,
Wang King Long, and Wang King Pao for the purpose of organising
a group called "The Grand Federation of China, Manchuokuo and Japan".
The head of this delegation is Liu Yu-chih, native of Dairen,
residing at No 12 Pingliang Terrace, Pingliang Road, Telephone No
50456.

The Federation's office is at Boone Road, in the house of a
Japanese, and leased by the Japanese. The members of the federation
are very active.

VERIFICATION.

The Grand Federation of China, Japan and Manchuria was
organised in Manchuokuo and is directed by the Japanese. This
organisation which is striving to extend its influence in China
recently sent Chinese to our city. These individuals have been
associating themselves with the loafer and coolie class, who are of
northern nativity.

The head of the Shanghai group is Liu Yu Chih alias
Liu Yao Ting, residing at No 12 Pingliang Terrace, Pingliang Road,
where he has established a factory called "Chiah Shun" manufacturing
Ribbons and Gloves.

译自一份日期为1935年7月4日的法文报告。

主题：名为“中日满大联盟”的团体的组织。

参考：
中日满大联盟。
中日关系。
中满关系。
特工“K”。

...............................

特工“K”通报了以下报告：
日本人最近派遣了三名代表满洲国的中国人前往上海，他们的名字是馬少卿、王金龍和王金寶，目的是组织一个名为“中日满大联盟”的团体。
该代表团的负责人是劉玉池，大连人，居住在平凉路平凉台12号，电话号码50456。

该联盟的办事处位于布恩路的一栋日本人房屋内，由日本人租赁。联盟成员非常活跃。

核实情况。

中日满大联盟是在满洲国组织的，由日本人指挥。该组织正努力将其影响力扩展到中国，最近派遣了一些中国人来到本市。这些人一直与北方籍的游民和苦力阶层交往。

上海团体的负责人是劉玉池，别名劉耀廷，居住在平凉路平凉台12号，他在那里建立了一家名为“嘉顺”的工厂，生产丝带和手套。
